title: Remove Boxes
goal: Solve Remove Boxes: Given boxes of different colours, repeatedly remove a run of k continuous boxes of the same colour for k*k points. Return the maximum total points obtainable.
strategy: Given boxes of different colours, repeatedly remove a run of k continuous boxes of the same colour for k*k points. Return the maximum total points obtainable.
inputRules: Keep it to 12 boxes or fewer (the DP is O(n^4))
